reviews.text:
I had such a lovely experience with Sophie today when I brought my kitten in for her nail clip and flea treatment.

As a relatively new cat owner, I can be quite anxious, particularly around my kitten’s claws and the possibility of being scratched. Sophie was incredibly kind, patient and reassuring throughout the whole appointment. She has such a genuinely warm and lovely manner and made me feel completely at ease.

What really impressed me was how quickly she understood my kitten’s temperament. Just from handling and observing her, Sophie described how she likely behaves at home and got her absolutely spot on! My kitten is normally quite nervous in unfamiliar situations and will often try to hide, run away or jump onto me, but she was incredibly calm and relaxed with Sophie.

Sophie also took the time to show me how to hold my kitten properly and safely, and explained exactly where the nails can be trimmed to without hurting her. She answered my questions without making me feel silly for being nervous or inexperienced.

It was genuinely the perfect vet visit and has given me much more confidence as a cat owner. You can clearly see that Sophie understands animals and really cares about both the pets and their owners.

Thank you so much, Sophie. 🐾
Denise is an absolute legend really helped me out with my old boy Rex the dog thank you so much 👍👍👍

I am absolutely devastated by my experience with Vets4Pets. I took my young, healthy rabbit in for what I believed would be a routine castration. I dropped him off at 9:15am, and by around 11am I was called and told that his heart had “crashed.” When I arrived at around 2pm, I was told he was brain dead and there was nothing more they could do, leaving me with no choice but to have him put to sleep.

I asked if an exotic vet could assess him, but I was told that there was nothing more that could be done. I was also told they didn’t know whether he had an underlying condition and that a blood test should have been done. I was told a colleague had suggested this to me yet he never did.

I understand that the risks were explained to me and that I signed the consent form, but I trusted the practice to provide appropriate care and assessment. I took my rabbit in expecting to bring him home that day and instead had to say goodbye to him.

I paid £138 and only received £85 back, with the rest being taken for cremation.

I am heartbroken and left with serious questions about the care, pre-operative assessment, rabbit-specific experience and anaesthetic management. I sincerely hope Vets4Pets properly reviews what happened and that other rabbit owners ask questions about the vet’s experience with rabbits before consenting to surgery.

Every time i visit pets at home its always so positive with advice on all my puppy's foods, treat vaccine meds.visiting the vets for the very first time was exceptionally staff are so friendly I want to thank Kathleen & Liz B for helping me with my puppy weenie absolutely a credit to your company have the best staff I have ever come across. Thanking you so much julie w .

A big thank you to Imanol for vaccinating my rabbit, carrying out a thorough health check, and giving me some great advice on rabbit care.

The funniest moment? Finding out that my beloved Dorothy isn't actually a girl after all, but a boy! 🤦🏻‍♂️ I had no idea.

What impressed me most was how relaxed Dorothy was throughout the appointment. Imanol clearly knows how to handle rabbits properly and made him feel comfortable from the start.

Update: Since writing my original review, Dorothy has also had her neutering surgery here, and my experience has been just as positive. Imanol clearly explained the procedure, what to expect during her recovery, and how to manage her feeding and medication afterwards.

The following day, when I was worried about Dorothy, they kindly offered to keep her at the clinic for the day so they could monitor and look after her. When I picked her up, Melody was wonderful and clearly explained how to care for Dorothy over the weekend. She was so kind and caring with her — Dorothy absolutely loved her!

There was also another lovely member of the team who was very kind and helpful, and I’m sorry I can’t remember her name.

After several visits, I feel very confident bringing Dorothy here. A genuinely caring and professional team.

The wonderful vets and staff gave us exceptional care. Informing us step by step of his treatment and giving us the reassurance that he was safe and comfortable in their care. The service went above and beyond.

Fantastic, compassionate and reassuring service from front desk staff, nurses and vets. Always take time to get to know and care for my dog and ensure that time spent with them is as stress free as possible for pet and owner! Thank you.

We’ve been bringing our two cats, Silvio and Giorgio, to Pets at Home for a while now, and every single visit reminds us why we trust this team so much. From the moment you walk in, the front desk staff make everything easy — friendly, organised, and genuinely caring.

The nurses are incredible. You can tell they love what they do; they handle our boys with so much patience and kindness, even when Silvio gets a bit shy or Giorgio decides he wants to explore everything.

And the vets… honestly, amazing. They take their time, explain things clearly, and you never feel rushed. They treat our cats like their own, and that’s something you can’t fake.

It’s rare to find a place where every single person makes you feel welcome and reassured, but this team does exactly that. We’re really grateful for the care they’ve given Silvio and Giorgio — and for the peace of mind they give us every time we walk through the door.
The vets and all staff are wonderful at this store nothing is to much trouble, so knowledgeable and pleasant to talk to

Dr Liz the vet has been absolutely amazing with our cat Koko. She needed to have some teeth removed, and as it was the first time one of our cats had ever been put under anaesthetic, we were extremely nervous and a little teary!

Liz was incredibly compassionate and reassuring throughout the whole process. She even managed to give us an update around midday, which really helped put our minds at ease. The procedure went extremely well, and it was clear that Koko was in such caring and capable hands.

We honestly cannot thank Liz and the team enough for looking after our fur baby so well. We’re incredibly grateful for her kindness, professionalism and care ❤️🐾

The team at Old Kent Road are absolutely fantastic! Hannah has been wonderful helping my cat Dolly with her weight management. We always receive the loveliest service, all our questions are answered with lots of kindness and she makes sure to make both me and Dolly feel very comfortable!

Thanks so much Hannah for all your help, and the rest of the team who always treat us so nicely. 😊

I can’t recommend Vets for Pets Old Kent Road highly enough. A special thank you to Eminol, who looked after my French Bulldog, Tokio, with exceptional care and professionalism.

Eminol always makes me feel reassured and confident that Tokio is in the best hands. He takes the time to explain everything clearly, is incredibly kind, and genuinely cares about his patients.

During the recent hot weather, I was particularly worried because French Bulldogs can struggle with the heat. The team were so understanding and allowed us to stay in the air-conditioned consulting room until Tokio had calmed down and was breathing comfortably before we went home. That level of compassion made such a difference and gave me real peace of mind.

Thank you, Eminol, and the whole team at Vets for Pets Old Kent Road, for your outstanding care, kindness, and professionalism. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend your practice to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.
They are very friendly supportive and understanding. Liz and Denise were brilliant and handled our case very well. Thank you guys xx
Cats need to life there live
Misdiagnosed my pet 2 times, please get new nurses/vets that are more educated

My 17 year old lurcher was slipping on smooth stair surfaces so I brought him to have is nails clipped.
It's not an easy job as he has black nails so it's hard to see how far you can go.
The nurse was great with him and was really careful. She was super knowledgeable and had great advice for me. He's running up and down stairs again now.
It was excellent value as it's a difficult and time consuming task.

What a magnificent and compassionate service that they provide.
I was corresponding with Kayla who has a very high standard of customer service and customer satisfaction.kayla had an empathetic approach and supported me on what to do and advocated on my behalf to the Pdsa as l did not have the money to go ahead with my cat June's emergency surgery which was over £2000. Kayla was able to set everything up for me which was amazing as l was very emotional due to my cat June's life threatening condition.
I would recommend this service as they go the extra mile.
A VERY BIG THANK YOU to the team and Kayla.
Staff were lovely as always, especially the reception staff and nurses! Always give my dog a big fuss, you can tell they love the animals that they see and are very knowledgeable

Absolutely brilliant staff! The customer service has been exceptional. Imanol, Ida and Kathleen have outstanding people and pet skills! This is definetly my kittens home away from home. I am so happy thanks guys!!

Saw me within an hour of calling

Great service

If I had any doubts before, they have now been completely put to rest. My pet, Amber, became unwell, and on a bank holiday, Pets at Home was the only place I could find for immediate assistance.

From the moment I arrived, I was met with exceptional care and compassion. The receptionists, Kathleen and Teresa, were truly outstanding. I was very distressed, but they both took the time to comfort and support me throughout what was a difficult experience. I was there for nearly an hour, and their kindness made a significant difference. Pets at home have employed staff members who are kind, caring and very efficient. A big thank you also to Denise and Ida at the reception area who helped to resolved my early arrival for another appointment and assured me not to worry about anything.

The veterinary professional who attended to Amber, Andrea was equally impressive. She was attentive, reassuring, and took the time to explain everything clearly and thoroughly, which helped ease my concerns.

I would like to extend my sincere thanks to all the staff at the Old Kent Road Pets at Home, including the sales team at the tills, especially George and Billy, for their professionalism and kindness. I would highly recommend this branch to anyone concerned about their pet’s wellbeing.
Kathleen and Dr Liz were amazing and reassuring. Such a positive experience would recommend it to all pets :)
wonderful service from the front desk and the vets are always so caring and knowledgeable. everyone is always ready to help out and always super helpful. would recommend to anyone! :)

Love this place! Receptionists (Kathleen and Theresa) are amazing, very personable and helpful. Melody, the veterinary nurse, is simply fantastic - both my cats love her and they especially love the licky-licks they get! All the staff are super helpful and knowledgeable. I bring my two cats here and wouldn't dream of going elsewhere as the practice is cat-friendly, clean and reasonably priced.

Amazing vet. Thank you so much Imanol and the team for looking after our fur family. Every time we come to see you always go above and beyond.

Would definitely recommend!

Brought my cat in late on a Saturday in a bad way. The vet stayed on late to make sure she was treated rather than putting us off to the next day and then made sure we got the right care over the next few weeks to make a full recovery.  The whole staff has been supportive and helpful throughout and I couldn't have wished for better treatment for my fur baby. Thank you!
Ida ,Kathleen, Lizard, Rozy Thank you so much looking after coco my cat Very helpful and  explaining everything to me Thank you again 😊 😀 …

Have been coming to vets for pets since adopting my cat, Penny 7 years ago. On a couple of occasions she was unwell and on one visit she required an X ray. I have always found the care towards Penny exemplary and I am well looked after too, with things being carefully explained.

Last Summer, Penny was put on a weight loss programme by Hannah. Unfortunately Penny was a little overweight and it was starting to affect her energy levels and grooming.
So together, Hannah and I have been on a mission to get the weight off.

I am a self confessed softie so have struggled at times, with Penny wrapping me round her little paw! Hannah has had the patience of a saint with both myself and Penny so slowly but surely the weight is coming off.

Hannah works with so much enthusiasm and knowledge and so it is with her help that we are winning. Not once has she judged or criticised, only encouraged!

Would highly recommend

I had a very good experience today.
Liz, the vet who saw my cat Bombón, was very patient and gentle. She handled her with care and stayed calm even when Bombón got stressed and scratched her slightly.
I called at 9am and got an appointment at 11:15am. The reception staff were very kind, helpful, and knowledgeable.
I’m very happy with the service. My pet plan covered the consultation, and I only paid for the medication. The system is clear and easy to understand.
Overall, a great experience. Thank you.

We brought our 4 cats in to have their claws trimmed and we was treated to nicely by all staff and nurse Hannah was so polite and welcoming to our cats they where treated with kindness and patience and when we have brought them in previously for their injections and to be spayed or neutered the staff made sure that they where well looked after and not scared all the reception staff are always lovely to us like Georgia Kathleen and Denise , thank you so so much to the wonderful staff at vets for pets for treating our cats and showing us their care for animals

Fitted my guinea pig in for an appointment last minute when her breathing suddenly sounded crackly. Really helpful appointment with Immanol who listened carefully, provided clear advice & the meds that will hopefully get my girl feeling better soon

I cannot say enough how amazing all the staff have been  the receptionist are lovely and so willing to help, the vets have really been amazing. Without these guys we would have been really stuck. My dog Willow is now on the road to recovery with her sight. So a big thank you from Me and Willow 🐶 …

Lovely, friendly and helpful staff from
receptionists to vets and nurses.Feels like family. Thank you for looking after my Benji .

I had a very sick boy an then found out he had pancreititis im so happy with liz she was so helpful so understanding and so thoughtful she also went through everything with me in detail and made me feel so much better
Very friendly and helpful reception team for my mums dog, Vet was also very good and took his time and was very thorough.
Really great team. Prices are high but they offer payment methods incl Klarna-like arrangements. I’ve always been made to feel well looked after and informed about my options

Ida, Kathy and Kathleen are genuinely a ray of sunshine. I must emphasis my attendance to this vet is purely due to the reception staff !! An amazing bunch of people who treat my pets like actual babies.
Brilliant service!!!
All the team is always very professional and caring. They always show genuine care and attention to my cat’s needs. Highly recommended

I want to praise Kathleen a really helpful receptionist at the desk for the vet service. She really went out of her way to go above and beyond dealing with a dietary problem for my daughter's cat. With a quick word to a vet she broke the news that there wasn't the specialist dry food available in store, but was able to get cans of specialist wet food to tide us over until dry food was delivered. But I was especially impressed by the way she acknowledged people as they queued up, letting everyone know they had been seen by her, telling them she recognised them and and would note their arrival for an appointment, if she was inputting into her computer she raised her head to say she would be with them in a minute... just perfectly polite, attentive, efficient friendly and calm,  human interaction at its best. A credit to the store.

Had such a positive experience at Pets at Home thanks to Kathleen, Kathy and Eda. They were all genuinely friendly, patient and really knew their stuff. You can tell they actually care about the animals and about making sure customers feel at ease. Nothing felt rushed and they took the time to answer our questions properly. They were great with our Cane Corso puppies
It made the whole visit easy and enjoyable.
They have been looking after Shadow for years. I took him to get his nails clipped, and the Vet and team were so helpful as always. I cannot fault the care they take of our pets.

Vets for Pets- Old Kent Road are an excellent establishment. I have my two cats registered with them from Kittens, they are coming on 5 and 2 now. I have also recommended them to my daughter whom has registered her two Kittens with them. The reception staff are very friendly and polite- my pets and I are always greeted with a friendly face and helpful manner. The veterinary staff are extremely friendly, empathetic and knowledgeable. My Cats are usually very relaxed and sometimes even purring with the vet. The Care Plan they offer, helps with costs. I have recommended Vets for Pets- Old Kent Road to my family and friends.
This was the worse place i have been they did a scan and blood test on my dog and all they wanted was to.do.more thing for money they did not care about my dog i would never go there again
Very friendly and helpful staff who took good care of my dog.
Worst Place

We are extremely grateful to this veterinary practice for their kindness and care. After our bird Frederico flew away, someone kind found him and brought him to this vet. The team took him in, looked after him, and kept him safe until he could be returned to us.

A special thank you to Dr. Rachel, who took care of Frederico, she was compassionate, attentive, and clearly genuinely cared about his wellbeing. He was returned to us in good health and even with treats, which meant the world to us.

We can’t thank the team enough for helping reunite us with our bird. Highly recommended.
They are very considerate of my nervous dog. And handle her gently

Amazing service provided by Ida.

Always kind with our dog to helps with everything what we need.

Also the rest of the team it very helpful.

Good place to bring any pets here.

Thank you Ida :)

Every time I visit the veterinary department on Old Kent Road, the vet Imanol is a 10 out of 10. He treats me well, is empathetic about the situations or problems I have with my dog, always finds solutions, and makes me feel at ease with his advice and support.

I would also like to mention that the receptionist, Ida, is a lovely woman. She helps me and is very patient when my English is not very good. She also helps me in Spanish, which makes me feel comfortable.

Please hire more people like them. I definitely recommend Vets for Pets to all our friends
My experience was amazing. Billyboy and Diya were very helpful and polite. No hassle and nothing was too much. I will always be using their service.

We recently lost our beautiful cat, Patty. Her death was sudden and shocking particularly for my son. I cannot thank the staff from Pets4Vets enough when I had to bring in Patty to the Old Kent Road branch for her to be prepared for cremation. They were so kind and compassionate and talked me through the whole process. They let me stay as long as I wanted with Patty in one of their consulting rooms until I was ready to leave. When the ashes arrived a week later (cremation undertaken by an external company), I was given them by a wonderful member of staff who brought out the ashes beautifully packaged and added my cats paw prints as an added extra. She also had a little cry with me. Honestly, this level of empathy means so much to me and my son as we grieve Patty's passing. To top it off we received a sympathy card in the post today too. Thank you Vets4Pets staff, you have gone above and beyond.

Terrible experience. Not sure what their appointment system is really used for. We had a 17:45 appointment. We arrived on time, but they told us that the customer at 18:00 arrived before us, so they let them in first, which means that they swapped 2 customers slots forcefully. What’s the point of the appointment system?
Very knowledgeable, very helpful, very reasonable prices and ongoing care options.
Large parking lot, friendly staff and quick service

My Chiquita had her neutering surgery there. The staff looked after her very well. They kept us informed all the time   I was expecting to receive her all messed up , crying and in pain. But she was ok not in pain and happy to see us. Thank you all for looking after her so well. I really appreciate you all ♥️♥️

Absolutely devastated and beyond disappointed. My perfectly healthy rabbit went in for a routine spay and didn’t make it. The whole experience was a mess from the start. I had an appointment booked for Tuesday, only to be told there was an emergency and I’d been bumped to the next day — no real apology or concern.

Not a single call, update, or check-in from anyone. It’s been silence for two weeks after losing my pet under their care. Completely unacceptable and heartless.

The team is super friendly, kind, patient, and clearly love animals :)

They took great care of my dog and explained everything really well. The place is clean, organized, and you can tell your pet is in good hands. Highly recommend!
Had a lovely experience with the vets and nurses at this practice. They’ve taken really good care of my bunny Pippi!

Probably the best experience i’ve had with a vet practice, everyone was absolutely lovely! Ida and Denise on reception were so helpful and kind and extremely good at their job. The vet manger was the most understanding and considerate vet I’ve ever dealt with! I called at 1730 (30 mins before they shut) and they still managed to get us an appointment!! They all stayed an hour past the end of their shift to help my pup and i can’t thank them enough. Vet folks don’t get enough praise! Thank you guys for being so great and thank you for helping my little doggy :)

We have been using this vet for several years, I can’t rate them highly enough! My dog was very unwell at the start of the year, after 2 weeks of full day and overnight stays he is now back to full health. The team and in particular Imanol was attentive, understanding and always willing to take the time to explain things to me.

Amazing service each time i visit, their always more then happy to give advice and a very speedy response if you need to make contact via email
Melody is just amazing with my luna when we come in for her nail trimming
Thank you for the great service
Lovely people on reception especially Denise that found me an appointment even though they are very busy. Very glad we made the move from medivet
need to be investigated for veterinary negligence!!! don't take your pets here as they treat them horribly!

Rachel Maier and her team are exactly the vets you will never want. They don’t care for the wellbeing of your pet, are superficial in diagnosis and dismissive with owners. This coupled with Rachel’s condescending attitude and straight up lies to cover for her staff misconduct, made it so that my cat was made to suffer a lot more and for unnecessary time. They really do not care nor are professional, the practice is quite unclean and the receptionists quite rude and unprepared.

Our dog got injured during the grooming. He’s had it done multiple times and has always acted calm and never experienced any issues. At Vets4Pets when they were trimming him, they cut his nail to the point he was bleeding and his paw hurt …
Super helpful and friendly. Imanol and Rodolfo have been especially kind and knowledgeable about Pippin, our little cat. We'll never go anywhere else...

The worst Vets4Pets experience I’ve ever had. They showed no genuine care for the pets, lacked respect, and were incredibly condescending. Money is the only language they speak. I would strongly advise avoiding them at all costs.
Very happy to help

Alright but honestly felt they were rushing to get paid. Brought my sick cat to figure what was going on and there were many problems with him, the vet just said they could only deal with ‘one symptom’ because they have 15 minutes. The …
Lovely place, staff very friendly, supportive and knowledgeable. I feel my pets are in good hands whenever I'm here.
Horrible service, booked appointment at 5:30, we arrived 5 min earlier, left alone for 30 min and no one came to give an explanation. They don’t care about you, nor your pet.
Absolutely brilliant stuff with so much knowledge and expertise !! Highly recommend!!!

I joined the pet plan paying approx £240 a year. I was advised that they provide a prescription worming tablet that caters for all parasites that I wouldn’t find over the counter. Sold. A year later, my dog gets ill. Things that look like …
Always friendly and helpful.  Big waiting area, good if your dog is a bit nervous around others.
Good location as it also has Petsathome facilities but the vets sometimes lack empathy and you’re not guaranteed the same vet each time
Always very helpful and service is top notch thank guy's for your hard work
Rachel has taken care of duchess who was disabled for over 10 years and the care has been Amazing I couldn’t ask for a better Vet and was so caring when she passed away …
